coverage_summary: Once-daily primary-source discovery across energy, infrastructure, grid capacity, logistics, production, regulation, capital access and institutions. The 27 Oct World Bank/ADB Uzbekistan US$371m programme is a distinct recent 60-substation grid-upgrade candidate. Cross-checked against 2025 distribution programme and 2026 REMIT regional market to avoid double-counting. Other screened signals: 2 Nov US ISM, 1 Nov OPEC+ output requirements, 15 Oct DRIVE Asian energy fund, Korea electrical equipment exports, FAO InFARM surveillance and OPCW scheduled governance conference. No proof of commissioned Uzbek MW or 3 Nov newly enacted financing.

review_limitations: Uzbekistan programme approval 27 Oct is older than the 3 Nov discovery date; not a newly approved 3 Nov loan.

Projected 3.3 GW renewable integration, 20,000 MWh annual loss savings, 11,700 jobs and 60 upgraded substations are not realized outputs.
